# Notable Creative AI Projects Since March 2023

Here's a summary of some of the most interesting creative projects involving AI:

## Film & Video
- **"The Frost" (2023)** - A 12-minute film by Waymark where every shot was generated by DALL-E 2, then animated with D-ID
- **"Genesis" Toys 'R' Us ad (2024)** - First major commercial made with OpenAI's Sora
- **Coca-Cola "Masterpiece" (2023)** - Combined live action, CGI, and generative AI to bring famous paintings to life
- **"Air Head" by shy kids (2024)** - A surreal Sora-generated short about a man with a balloon for a head

## Music
- **"Heart on My Sleeve" (2023)** - The viral AI-generated "Drake & The Weeknd" song that sparked industry-wide debate
- **The Beatles' "Now and Then" (2023)** - Used AI to isolate John Lennon's vocals from an old demo, completing the band's "final" song
- **Grimes' Elf.Tech** - Platform letting anyone create songs with her AI voice and split royalties

## Visual Art & Photography
- **Boris Eldagsen's "The Electrician" (2023)** - Won (then refused) the Sony World Photography Award after revealing it was AI-generated
- **Refik Anadol's "Unsupervised"** at MoMA - AI-generated visualization of MoMA's collection
- **The "Balenciaga Pope" (2023)** - Viral Midjourney image that became a cultural moment about AI deception

## Interactive & Games
- **Suno and Udio** - Music generation platforms enabling anyone to create full songs from text prompts
- **Showrunner (Fable Studio)** - "South Park" AI episode generator demo, later evolving into a streaming-style platform
- **AI Dungeon and Character.AI explosion** - Interactive storytelling platforms with millions of users

## Notable Experiments
- **"Nothing, Forever"** - 24/7 AI-generated Seinfeld parody on Twitch (briefly banned for problematic content)
- **Marvel's "Secret Invasion" opening (2023)** - Controversial use of AI-generated title sequence
- **Runway Gen-2/Gen-3 short films** - Hundreds of filmmakers using Runway for indie projects and AI Film Festivals

Would you like me to go deeper on any particular medium or project?
